**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 already delivers our preferred assignment position:

- **§ 24.1** — we may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (prompt notice plus assignee assumption only).
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor is restricted: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld for a capable, financially sound assignee), and never to a direct competitor.
- **§ 24.3** — the residual mutual consent requirement is scoped to "other assignments," so it does not swallow our § 24.1 carve-out.
- **§ 24.4** — our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service, and Vendor must cooperate with successor administrative changes.
- **§ 13.3** — licence transfer rights track Section 24, so the licence follows a permitted assignment.

I also confirmed no other change-of-control or deemed-assignment trigger exists; § 9.2 is insolvency-based and expressly excludes a lawful reorganization that does not impair performance.
